convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'Heiken_Ashi_Smoothed' custom indicator with non-standard smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). Includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for money management and position open/close logic. Custom indicator buffers (buffer 4) must be replicated in Python.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: When SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are both true and previous bar trend (TrendValue[1]) is 0 (bearish), force SELL_Close=true - closes existing short on re-entry short signal. Same logic for BUY_Close when TrendValue[1]==1 (bullish) with BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose both true.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot (MM treated as lot size), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of deposit (MM treated as fraction). Default LOT mode means MM=0.1 is interpreted as 0.1 lots.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal is read from buffer index 4 of Heiken_Ashi_Smoothed custom indicator (trend direction: 1=bullish, 0=bearish). Long triggers when TrendValue[0]==1 && TrendValue[1]==0 (trend flips from bearish to bullish). Short triggers when TrendValue[0]==0 && TrendValue[1]==1 (trend flips from bullish to bearish). SignalBar input (default 1) shifts which bar is read, making it configurable to use previous bar vs current bar. When SignalBar=0, signals are checked on every tick; otherwise only on new bar. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans act as feature toggles to independently enable/disable each direction's entry and exit. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with built-in margin checking.
python_conversion_notes: The Heiken_Ashi_Smoothed custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it uses configurable smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) beyond standard MA types. Buffer 4 contains the binary trend signal (0 or 1). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position sizing (5 margin modes), order placement with deviation, and position closing - this logic must be ported. SL/TP are in points (not pips) so digit-adjustment is broker-dependent but the EA does not auto-adjust. Signal logic is straightforward: trend flip on buffer 4. The new-bar guard uses CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
